The Commission has considered the comments/ suggestions/ objections of the stakeholders, and the analysis/decision of the Commission thereon is dealt with in relevant paragraphs of this order. - 8.7 The Commission has noted the submissions of the stakeholders. As discussed in paragraph 13 of the proposal, the Commission has reviewed the normative capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 with reference to the capital cost norms specified by various State Commissions and project-specific tariff orders issued by various State Commissions based on prevailing market conditions. The review indicates that the capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 is broadly aligned with the prevailing market conditions. Accordingly, the Commission has decided to retain the normative capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 for the third year (FY 2026-27) of the Control Period. However, the capital cost of various technologies will be reviewed as part of the exercise of finalisation of RE Tariff Regulations for the next control period. _Period and by the latest available notified Corporate Tax rate for the remaining Tariff Period.”_ - 9.2 **MPPCL** submitted that the Commission may review the normative Return on Equity (RoE) considering the maturity of renewable energy technologies, reduced project risks, and prevailing regulatory and financing conditions. - 9.3 The ROE for determining the generic tariff is as per the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024.
